description: This file contains unit tests for encoding and decoding 'AnyCodable' values in the OpenClaw protocol, verifying JSON serialization behavior with various data structures.

classes.name: AnyCodableEncodingTests
classes.description: A struct containing test cases for encoding 'AnyCodable' values with Swift's Codable and JSON serialization.

methods.name: `encodes swift array and dictionary values`
methods.description: Test that a Swift dictionary with mixed types can be encoded into JSON and the resulting JSON object matches expectations.

methods.name: `protocol any codable encodes primitive arrays`
methods.description: Test that a dictionary with mixed typed array including primitives, NSNull, and nested dictionaries can be encoded and decoded correctly.
